SIALADENITIS
Acute infection and inflammation of the salivary glands
Types:
- Parotitis (mumps – acute, non-suppurative)
- The most common sialadenitis
- Mainly affects children
- Usually not related to sialolithiasis
- Suppurative parotitis
- Chronic sialadenitis
- Sub-mandibular sialadenitis
- Less common in children
- Abundant salivary flow with rich mucus component
- Rapid excretion
